data.body: [P2] Return to the design phase for the grouping option. CONTRIBUTING rule 3 requires an agreed design note before adding an option, and rule 2.5 requires explaining which simpler alternatives were considered and rejected. The supplied description documents the implementation and deployment timings but neither contains nor links that rationale. This approach introduces a dispatch protocol and a second representation of function settings in `settingsKey`/`CUSTOM_SETTINGS`. Follow rule 8's design process and obtain maintainer agreement; consider deriving groups from the existing generated function settings to avoid duplicated configuration knowledge.
